dataset.name: Inspection
dataset.description:
This dataset provides the inspection case detail for OSHA inspections. The dataset includes information about why the inspection was conducted.

Additional records can be viewed and/or downloaded from OSHA’s website at www.osha.gov/data.

code_snippets.code:
# Import libraries
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

# Get metadata
metadata_url = "https://api.dol.gov/v4/get/OSHA/inspection/json/metadata"
params = list("X-API-KEY"="<APIKEY>")
metadata_request = GET(metadata_url, query=params)
metadata = as.data.frame(fromJSON(content(metadata_request, "text")))

# Get data
data_url = "https://api.dol.gov/v4/get/OSHA/inspection/json"
params = list("X-API-KEY"="<APIKEY>", "limit"="10")
data_request = GET(data_url, query=params)
data = as.data.frame(fromJSON(content(data_request, "text")))

# Import libraries
import requests, pandas as pd

# Get metadata
metadata_url = "https://api.dol.gov/v4/get/OSHA/inspection/json/metadata"
params = {"X-API-KEY":"<APIKEY>"}
metadata_request = requests.get(metadata_url, params=params, verify=False)
metadata_json = metadata_request.json()
metadata = pd.DataFrame(metadata_json)

# Get data 
data_url = "https://api.dol.gov/v4/get/OSHA/inspection/json"
params = {"X-API-KEY":"<APIKEY>", "limit":"10"}
data_request = requests.get(data_url, params=params, verify=False)
data_json = data_request.json()['data']
data = pd.DataFrame(data_json)

dataset_metadatum.column_desc: Identifies the OSHA federal or state reporting jurisdiction
The flag used to identify a State. (Note: This field is not populated)
State postal abbreviation of site inspected
Postal zip code of site inspected
The unique code number that is assigned to the NAICS.
A=Accident. B=Complaint. C=Referral. D=Monitoring. E=Variance. F=FollowUp. G=Unprog Rel. H=Planned. I=Prog Related. J=Unprog Other. K=Prog Other. L=Other-L. M=Fat/Cat. N=Unprog Emph

A=No Insp/Not Found.B=No Insp/Out of Business.C=No Insp/Process Inactive.D=No Insp/10 or Fewer Empe.E=No Insp/Denied Entry.F=No Insp/SIC not on PG.G=No Insp/Exempt Voluntary.H=No Insp/NonExempt Consult.I=No Insp/Other.J=No Insp/Employer Exempted By Appropriation Act
Indicates union representation during inspection (Yes=Y/U/A. No=N/B/blank)
Indicates when the inspection was started.

Date the inspection or associated violations were last affected by updating (yyyymmdd). Note: this field was only recently added to the database to facilitate the transfer process.  Therefore. case not affected by updating in April. 2004 or later will have zero in this field.
